        {
          "stepNumber": 1,
          "part": null,

          "studentWork": "LHS = tanθ/(1 − cotθ) + cotθ/(1 − tanθ)\n= (sinθ/cosθ)/((sinθ − cosθ)/sinθ) + (cosθ/sinθ)/((cosθ − sinθ)/cosθ)\n= sin²θ/(cosθ(sinθ − cosθ)) − cos²θ/(sinθ(sinθ − cosθ))",

          "marksAwarded": 1,
          "marksDeducted": 0,

          "mistakeType": null,
          "correctedWorking": null,
          "isDeparture": false,
          "departureKind": null,
          "isReturn": false
        },
        {
          "stepNumber": 2,
          "part": null,
          "description": "Combine over common denominator and factorize (sin³θ − cos³θ)",
          "studentWork": "= (sin³θ − cos³θ)/(sinθ cosθ (sinθ − cosθ))\n= (sinθ − cosθ)(sin²θ + sinθ cosθ + cos²θ)/(sinθ cosθ (sinθ − cosθ))",
          "status": "correct",
          "marksAvailable": 1,
          "marksAwarded": 1,
          "marksDeducted": 0,
          "teacherAnnotation": "✓ Correct application of a³ − b³ identity",
          "mistakeType": null,
          "correctedWorking": null,
          "isDeparture": false,
          "departureKind": null,
          "isReturn": false
        },
        {
          "stepNumber": 3,
          "part": null,
          "description": "Simplify using sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 and reach RHS",
          "studentWork": "= (1 + sinθ cosθ)/(sinθ cosθ)\n= 1/(sinθ cosθ) + 1\n= 1 + secθ cosecθ = RHS. Hence proved.",
          "status": "correct",
          "marksAvailable": 1,
          "marksAwarded": 1,
          "marksDeducted": 0,
          "teacherAnnotation": "✓ Correct simplification to RHS and conclusion",
          "mistakeType": null,
          "correctedWorking": null,
          "isDeparture": false,
          "departureKind": null,
          "isReturn": false
        }
      ],
      "mistakeSummary": {
        "conceptual": 0,
        "calculation": 0,
        "silly": 0,
        "presentation": 0
      },
      "studentFinalAnswer": "1 + secθ cosecθ = RHS. Hence proved.",
      "finalAnswerCorrect": true,
      "teacherNote": "Excellent and well-structured proof. All trigonometric identities and algebraic factorizations are applied accurately with clear steps."
    }
  ],
  "summary": "Full marks awarded. The proof is mathematically rigorous, clearly formatted, and includes all necessary intermediate steps."
